children: ) today announced the launch of Travis Upload & Go℠, an AI-powered quoting tool that streamlines the workers compensation submission process for independent insurance agents serving small businesses.
removes manual data entry from the workers compensation quoting process, allowing agents to spend less time on paperwork and more time with their customers. Through
, insurance agents upload documents, such as ACORD applications, standard industry forms and handwritten notes, to initiate a quote. The new tool then:
Extracts information from the uploaded documents.
Generates a bindable workers compensation quote in half the time.

In an August 2026 Travelers survey of more than 150 small business insurance agents, 77% agreed that manual data entry is one of the most time-consuming and least valuable parts of their job. Fifty-four percent reported spending at least a quarter of their workday on it.
“We know speed matters when agents are quoting,” said Erin Rodliff, President of Small Commercial at Travelers. “
removes cumbersome data entry from their workflow so they can reinvest that time in the customer relationships that grow their business.”
is accessible to independent agents within Travis®, Travelers’ rate, quote and issue platform for small business insurance policies. For more information, visit Travelers.com/UploadandGo.
